record.dic_text:
01273 Barchumiy {bar-khu-mi:'}

0978 的變化型; 形容詞

欽定本 - Barhumite 1; 1

巴魯米人
1) 一位由巴戶琳來的人, 巴戶琳位在由約旦河谷上至取路撒冷的路上或其附近,
   靠近便雅憫屬地的南界 (#撒下 23:31|)
record.edic_text:
01273 Barchumiy {bar-khoo-mee'}

by transposition for 0978;; adj

AV - Barhumite 1; 1

Barhumite = "son of the blackened: in the pitied"
1) a person from Bahurim, a village apparently on or close to the
   road leading up from the Jordan valley to Jerusalem, and near the
   south boundary of Benjamin
